title: Change price: one store refused
summary: The Change price dialog after confirming, when the App Store took $3.99 but Google Play refused: the title says 1 of 2 stores, each store's row shows its result (Changed; Not changed with why and the fix in Play Console), Steam is unchanged, and Try Google Play again retries only that store.
compare: The dialog stays open after a partial result; its title states the count ('Price changed on 1 of 2 stores') and the first line says what each store now charges.

Each store row shows its own result: App Store 'Changed' as success status with the time; Google Play as a danger row: its name, a Not changed pill, the cause in Play Console's words (the service account lacks Manage store presence), the exact account to fix, and Open Play Console.

Try Google Play again (primary, focused) retries only the failed store with the same idempotency key; the typed confirmation isn't asked again. Close leaves the offer in a mismatch the editor shows: 'Base price $3.99 · Google Play still at $2.99' as a warning on the Price card, with the same retry.
Nothing is rolled back on the store that succeeded; the base price is recorded as $3.99 with Google Play's mismatch listed, and Activity records both outcomes.
While sending, the confirm button shows its busy state ('Changing price on 2 stores…') and the dialog can't be dismissed; each row shows a spinner until its store answers.
Phone: the same bottom sheet; the failed row's text wraps and its link stays under it.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

findings.issue: Dialog title and close misaligned; two icon tile sizes; reassurance copy far from the price; confirm label on two lines; four sample currencies.
findings.resolution: Title and close share a 32px row; one 24px tile; 'Players who already bought Dice skins keep it' sits under the price field; the confirm label is one line with the product name as a mono chip; two sample currencies; the Google Play service account is its own copyable mono row.

findings.issue: Drop the typed confirmation for price changes.
findings.resolution: declined: The consolidation plan (2.7) requires a typed confirmation for store price changes; an owner decision.
